headline: Argentine Treasury Offers Short-Term FX-Linked Debt to Roll Over $16 Billion
summary: Argentina's Ministry of Economy offered eight short-term debt instruments to domestic investors in an effort to roll over 25 trillion pesos in maturing obligations.
why: Sovereign debt roll-over auctions in Argentina reflect local financial sector liquidity and central bank exchange rate protection mechanisms.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Short-term debt auctions test market demand for domestic currency sovereign paper.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Treasury debt issuance details created mixed investor sentiment regarding near-term sovereign refinancing capabilities.
